accountId.description: The account these changes belong to.

oldState.description: The state this response starts from (matches sinceState from the request).

newState.description: The current state after all listed changes; pass to the next call.

hasMoreChanges.description: If true, additional changes exist beyond maxChanges. Call again with newState.

created.description: IDs of emails created since sinceState.

updated.description: IDs of emails whose properties changed since sinceState.

destroyed.description: IDs of emails destroyed since sinceState.
